import Part, Sketcher
from FreeCAD import Vector as V
doc = App.getDocument("hook_lesson3")
body = doc.getObject("Body")
sk = body.newObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "HoleSketch")
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(doc.getObject("YZ_Plane"), "")]
sk.MapMode = "FlatFace"
doc.recompute()
# sketch x -> global Y, sketch y -> global Z; back face centre is Y=-10, Z=30
for z in (15, 45):
    i = sk.addGeometry(Part.Circle(V(-10, z, 0), V(0, 0, 1), 2), False)
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Diameter", i, 4))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceY", 0, 3, 1, 3, 30))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Vertical", 0, 3, 1, 3))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceX", -1, 1, 0, 3, -10))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceY", -1, 1, 0, 3, 15))
doc.recompute()
pk = body.newObject("PartDesign::Pocket", "ScrewHoles")
pk.Profile = sk
pk.Type = 1  # ThroughAll
pk.Midplane = True
doc.recompute()
print("sketch ok", sk.FullyConstrained, "vol", body.Shape.Volume, pk.State)
print([ (c.Radius, c.Center) for f in body.Shape.Faces if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder" for c in [f.Surface]])

doc = App.getDocument("hook_lesson3")
body = doc.getObject("Body")
shape = body.Shape
name = None
for i, e in enumerate(shape.Edges, 1):
    bb = e.BoundBox
    if abs(bb.XMin-40)<1e-6 and abs(bb.XMax-40)<1e-6 and abs(bb.ZMin-10)<1e-6 and abs(bb.ZMax-10)<1e-6:
        name = "Edge%d" % i; print(name, bb)
f = body.newObject("PartDesign::Fillet", "LipFillet")
f.Base = (doc.getObject("ScrewHoles"), [name])
f.Radius = 2
doc.recompute()
print(f.State, body.Tip.Name, body.Shape.Volume, body.Shape.isValid())
